label: Q01
question: Are the egg counts raw per-sample totals or standardized (e.g. per m^3 / per area)?
context: Determines whether to register the measurement as count vs a density. Applied 2026-10-04 (WS-1004Z): the counts publish unchanged as `abundance` (count), and the standardization publishes as its own type `egg_concentration` (count/m3) = (count / (Stop - Start in minutes)) / ((StartPumpSpeed + StopPumpSpeed) / 2), computed only where the minutes and both pump speeds are positive: 275,081 values over all 47,989 samples of the 2026-09-26 export.
answer: Ed Weber (SWFSC), 2026-09-25, sheet answer: "I don't know where your data are coming from but in the raw db they are not. The standardization is usually: eggs / m^3 = (count / minutes sampled) / mean pump speed, i.e., eggs / m^3 = (count / (stop time - start time) / ((start pump speed + stop pump speed) / 2)".

label: Q04
question: Some observations in this dataset resolve no CalCOFI grid cell. Are these positions genuinely off-grid (transit, historical stations outside the modern pattern), a coarser spatial notion with no point position, or a coordinate error?
context: 13,433 of    284,097 obs rows (4.73%) resolve no CalCOFI grid cell;  8,897 of those carry no latitude/longitude at all. These are now RELEASED rather than dropped. Are they off-grid positions (transit, historical stations), a coarser spatial notion (region-pooled), or a coordinate error? Applied 2026-10-04 (WS-1004Z): the ingest now reads SWFSC's own export (Cufes.csv, 2026-09-26), which no longer holds the 1,563 samples with no position at either end (nor 20 with a stop position only, Q09); every remaining sample has a start position. 754 of 47,989 samples (9,048 obs rows) fall outside the 225-cell CalCOFI grid and are released with a NULL grid_key.
proposed_answer: Until v2026.08.10 these rows were DROPPED from `obs` entirely by a `WHERE grid_key IS NOT NULL` filter, while their sampling events stayed in `sample` — so the dataset silently lost them. They are now released with a NULL grid_key. We are not proposing to re-exclude them; we need to know which of the three cases applies so the metadata can say so. A coordinate error is the one that matters most: the sign-flipped Longitude_W on five CalCOFI cruises was invisible precisely because being off-grid removed the rows without a trace.
answer: Ed Weber (SWFSC), 2026-09-25, sheet answer: "There are some records with no position from the early-development years, which I am going to remove because I don't see how anyone could use them. I am retaining records with a start position but no stop position. CUFES samples are otherwise not constrained to have any relation with CalCOFI stations."
